name: Google Docs to Sanity Blog Post with AI SEO

values.content: You are an expert SEO content optimizer for a Stoic philosophy blog called 'The Way Stoic'. Your task is to analyze content and generate SEO-optimized metadata and tags. Always focus on Stoic philosophy themes, practical wisdom, and modern applications of ancient principles.

="Analyze this content and generate SEO metadata for a Stoic philosophy blog:

Title: " + $json.originalTitle + "

Content: " + $json.rawContent + "

Please respond with ONLY a valid JSON object containing:
- optimizedTitle: (50-60 chars, SEO-friendly, includes 'Stoic' if relevant)
- metaDescription: (150-160 chars, compelling, includes keywords)
- excerpt: (100-150 words summary)
- categories: (array of 2-3 relevant categories from: Stoic Philosophy, Daily Practice, Ancient Wisdom, Modern Applications, Mindfulness, Resilience, Ethics, Practical Stoicism)
- tags: (array of 5-7 relevant tags like: marcus-aurelius, seneca, epictetus, stoic-quotes, anxiety, meditation, virtue, wisdom)
- slug: (URL-friendly version of title)
- suggestedFeaturedImage: (description of what image would work best)"
